Our Story

Acme Precision was founded in 1979 by Walter Brandt in a two-bay garage. Family owned since 1979, the company now runs two plants.

Walter Brandt is the founder and President of Acme Precision. He began his career as a tool and die apprentice and has led the company through four decades of growth. Walter serves on the board of directors of the Fort Worth Metalworking Association and is a member of the Haltom City Economic Development Council.

Walter Brandt

| President

Karen Brandt

| CFO

His daughter Karen Brandt joined the company in 2012 and leads finance and operations as the second generation of the family.

Our main facility is located in Haltom City, TX and our second plant is located in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

Industries we serve

  • Aerospace and defense
  • Oil and gas
  • Medical devices

Today our team of 85 skilled machinists runs two shifts.
